cues: During cyclocross, racers dismount to carry their machines up muddy stairs, remounting beyond the barriers.
On a triathlon course, athletes leave the pool, grab helmets, and mount their machines in the transition area.
A parent pulls a covered trailer carrying a sleeping toddler along a riverside path on a family outing.
During rehabilitation, a patient pedals an indoor trainer while a therapist monitors heart rate and knee alignment.
At the farmers’ market, a shopper straps apples onto a front-loading cargo frame, then pedals home through quiet streets.
At an urban polo match, players keep one hand on the handlebars while swinging mallets at the ball.
